goal: Test whether strictly-past 6-of-49 draw contexts have reproducible analogues whose known next draws improve a fixed top-8 pool over a same-game marginal-frequency baseline and an exact matched random pool.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: v319 models variable-order symbolic context probabilities directly; v321 performs nonparametric analogue retrieval in a continuous recency-state space and predicts only from already-observed successor draws.
v320 models gap-composition scores; v321 uses similarity between complete recent-state vectors and historical analogue successors.

method.contextVector: For target t and context length C, each number n receives sum_{r=1..C} I[n appeared at t-r] * exp(-(r-1)/C). The 49-vector is L2-normalized.
method.analogueLibrary: For each target t, consider at most the 512 most recent historical endpoints j strictly before t. Build the same vector from draws before j; its successor outcome is draw j. Candidate j is admissible only when all context draws and successor j were known before target t.
method.rbfGamma: 1 / median squared distance across the frozen admissible analogue library for the target; no fitted target outcome enters gamma.
method.prediction: Take K most similar admissible analogue contexts. Score each number by similarity-weighted inclusion frequency in their already-known successor draws. Emit top 8, ties by number ascending.
method.sameGameBaseline: Top 8 marginal frequencies over the same frozen frequencyWindow preceding each target.
